messages:
Alex W: Heads-up — p99 on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate jumped right after the quota fanout change, but per-backend logs don't show the same spike :thinking:
Samir Patel: I noticed a bump too, could be a rollup merge artifact. Can you paste the exact dashboard query/panel config?
Alex W: here's the panel query I'm debugging:
```sql
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99
FROM rollups
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND env = 'prod' AND ts >= now() - interval '60 minutes'
GROUP BY route_merge_key
```
but when I run a tail on the backend logs p99 is flat.
Priya Rao: do we surface `sample_origin`/`kvcache_hit` in that rollup? if those tags are collapsed during merge a few heavy requests can distort percentiles when routes are combined. Also quota fanout can duplicate client tags.
Maria Chen: yep — my hunch is aggregation strips some route-level tags before tdigest merge. when fanout runs, the same logical request touches multiple backends and we end up collapsing `kvcache_hit` into a single bucket. that masks the cache-hit vs miss split.
Alex W: quick repro: filter the panel to `tag:kvcache_hit=true` — p99 stays normal. set it to `all` and p99 shoots up. so the aggregation is dropping tag weighting.
Samir Patel: can you add `sample_count` and `effective_sample_weight` to the panel? low effective samples + interpolation can aggressively extrapolate tail quantiles.
Priya Rao: short-term mitigation: prevent merging rollups across `kvcache_hit` and `sample_origin`. long-term: use weighted tdigest merge (preserve per-tag centroids) instead of naive concat. I'll write a short RFC.
Maria Chen: filing infra ticket now — infra-agg-1425. tagging: aggregation, rollups, console. @ops-bot any blockers for pushing a small change to agg-service?
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline status: agg-service canary in progress (1/3), no blockers reported, ETA ~14m :gear:.
Alex W: thanks — I'll update the dashboard to split by `kvcache_hit` and add an annotation for the spike. also adding a note in the release doc to warn about rollup caveats.
Priya Rao: also add a short tooltip to the latency panel explaining `sample_origin` and why merged rollups can flip p99. helps SREs when they triage.
Samir Patel: I'll follow up with a tiny console UI patch to surface `effective_sample_count` next to percentiles.
Alex W: appreciated. filing a quick PR to pin the dashboard to per-endpoint splits for the short term.
Maria Chen: closing loop — posted link to infra-agg-1425 in the release thread and added reproduction steps.
